evidence.observation: Growth held at ~750 °C setpoint after initial settling from 755 °C; stable through t=3300
Flow tracked 100 sccm in growth and 200 sccm in cooldown
~3.0 Torr in growth with a brief ~3.23 Torr excursion at k=118-121, then normal; ~3.97 Torr in cooldown consistent with doubled Ar flow
Heater off (~0%) in cooldown with steady ~0.45 °C/s cooling
Exhaust O2 stayed low (1-7 ppm) throughout, no leak signature

args.missing_evidence: Post-growth characterization (e.g., Raman/optical/AFM) of the sample to determine whether the target film grew.
